title: WireGuard mesh pick + Authentik SSO for Coolify
summary: Three WireGuard control planes compared (NetBird recommended), the broader zero-trust VPN landscape for SMB interconnect, and exact Authentik SSO settings for Coolify dashboard login.

sections.heading: Zero-trust VPN landscape (SMB interconnect)
bullets: Best fits for sites + servers + people: WireGuard mesh + IdP (NetBird, Tailscale, Headscale) vs app/edge ZTNA (Cloudflare Zero Trust, Twingate).
Coolify one-click today: netbird-client, tailscale-client, cloudflared, wireguard-easy — not NetBird/Headscale control planes.
Pros — NetBird: Authentik-native, mesh + routes, SaaS or self-host. Tailscale: polish, Authentik supported, Coolify client. Cloudflare ZT: free tier edge/Access companion.
Cons — Tailscale: SaaS control plane + seat cost. Twingate: Authentik not a supported IdP. Headscale: lean but no first-party UI; OIDC groups cannot drive ACLs.
Recommendation: lead with NetBird; Cloudflare Tunnel as edge companion; Tailscale only if polish > sovereignty.

sections.heading: NetBird vs Defguard vs Headscale
bullets: NetBird: full mesh (own clients + control plane); P2P WireGuard + relay; routing peers / exit nodes; first-class Authentik.
Defguard: hub-and-spoke gateway VPN + IAM; per-connection WireGuard MFA; external OIDC/Authentik needs Business tier; not any-to-any mesh.
Headscale: Tailscale control server only + official Tailscale clients; Authentik supported; OIDC groups cannot be used in ACLs; no first-party admin UI.
Coolify: NetBird client one-click; Defguard/Headscale server not one-click.
Rank for this stack: 1) NetBird 2) Headscale 3) Defguard (only if connect-time MFA / gateway model outweighs mesh).

sections.heading: Authentik SSO for Coolify (exact values)
bullets: Use Coolify Settings → OAuth → Authentik (named card), Coolify ≥ v4.3.0 — not generic OIDC and not Traefik forward-auth for dashboard login.
Redirect URI (Authentik Strict + Coolify field): https://coolify.efortune.tech/auth/authentik/callback
Coolify Base URL: https://auth.efortune.tech (origin only — no /application/o/slug/).
Authentik: Confidential OAuth2/OIDC; scopes openid profile email; bind coolify-admins; MFA on Authentik flow (Coolify 2FA is password-only).
After accounts exist: Registration Allowed = off; keep break-glass local admin password.
Coolify matches by email only — no IdP group → Coolify role mapping.
